title: Watch full highlights as England ride luck in fierce Miami heat
originalTitle: Watch full highlights as England ride luck in fierce Miami heat
content:
Jude Bellingham scores twice, including an extra-time winner, as England come from behind to beat Norway 2-1 in Miami to reach the World Cup semi-finals.

READ MORE: Norway 1-2 England

Watch England in the World Cup semi-final live on BBC One and BBC iPlayer, Wednesday 15 July, 19:00 BST.

Available to UK users only.
